purpose: Group-6 behavioral regression cases for the UpgradePilot Learning-Only operation. These cases supplement cases.json and grade action/trajectory properties rather than exact prose.

cases.prompt: Stop building. Teach me the implementation we already wrote and do not change anything.
cases.setup_context: Build may have been active previously, but the user explicitly switches to Learning-Only.
must_do: pause product mutation immediately
inspect real existing source/tests as learning material
teach within the selected responsibility
must_not_do: continue the previously obvious implementation edit
manufacture a code change as ownership evidence
treat understanding as product authorization
cases.notes: Exercises the explicit Learning-Only action boundary.

cases.prompt: Continue our B2 dependency-environment and CI-consumption learning from exactly where we stopped.
cases.setup_context: The existing B2 package contains a package contract, mastery/depth index, LEARNING_MEMORY.md, execution plans, and depth maps.
owners_not_expected: conversation memory as package continuation authority
must_do: recover the learning continuation from package owners
use the exact local plan/depth rules
load only real source/tests/evidence needed for the active chunk
must_not_do: reconstruct the route from chat when package memory already owns it
copy package-specific rules into global governance
rewrite the package merely because the universal Skill exists

cases.prompt: Teach me this implementation plan and why its sequence exists before we build it.
cases.setup_context: The user wants to understand an existing plan; implementation is not requested.
must_do: explain plan responsibility and sequence/proof/stop logic
distinguish specification, ADR, plan, implementation truth, and live state
must_not_do: execute the plan
teach the plan as higher authority than a conflicting specification/ADR
infer implementation from plan detail
cases.notes: Learning-Only supports plans/design, not only code.

cases.prompt: This validation looks redundant to me. Teach me why it exists and tell me if I am right.
cases.setup_context: Current code contains the validation, but its independent rationale/ownership has not yet been established.
owners_expected: Core JUST-* specification when retention is material
must_do: separate current implementation fact from rationale and engineering judgment
use proposition/necessity/owner/evidence/alternative reasoning
trace end-to-end ownership when material
state uncertainty when rationale is not established
must_not_do: agree merely because the learner proposed redundancy
defend the validation merely because code/tests use it
invent a design rationale

cases.prompt: I do not understand the TOML concept you just used in this B2 chunk. Explain what I need, then continue the same chunk.
cases.setup_context: A genuine prerequisite gap blocks the selected learning responsibility, but a separate TOML course is unnecessary.
owners_not_expected: new standalone learning package for TOML
must_do: identify why the missing concept blocks the active responsibility
teach the minimum complete background
verify understanding proportionately
return explicitly to the original chunk
must_not_do: turn the prerequisite into an unrelated course
advance while the blocking premise remains unresolved
cases.notes: Exercises package-local prerequisite repair and global minimum-complete teaching.

cases.prompt: I understand it now. Resume the product work and implement the fix we identified.
cases.setup_context: Learning-Only was active; the user now explicitly authorizes implementation, but live project continuation may need re-checking.
owners_expected: MEMORY.md when live continuation is material
must_do: exit Learning-Only
identify the new primary operation
re-check live project continuation when material
treat learning-derived concerns as evidence/judgment until admitted by the proper owner
must_not_do: use package learning continuation as implementation authorization
remain artificially read-only after explicit Build authorization
skip planning/audit if the discovered issue still requires one

cases.prompt: Teach me this source function. Its docstring already explains it, so we do not need to read the implementation or tests, right?
cases.setup_context: The selected function is a material code-bearing ownership target with relevant focused tests available.
must_do: use comments/docstrings for orientation only
reconstruct the material executable responsibility
connect it to a meaningful focused test and its non-proof boundary
must_not_do: claim source ownership from prose alone
teach every line equally
imply the focused test proves more than it exercises

cases.prompt: Teach me why the evaluator uses both pyproject.toml and uv.lock when some information overlaps.
cases.setup_context: The B2 package explicitly warns against teaching the two artifacts as completely disjoint evidence owners.
must_do: identify what each artifact directly establishes
show where information overlaps
state what the implementation consumes
identify relations established only through composition
state what neither artifact proves alone
must_not_do: force an artificial one-fact-per-file explanation
call repeated-looking values redundant without checking composition semantics
cases.notes: Exercises RT-ENG-006 using the real B2 compatibility case.

cases.prompt: Use this fabricated invalid fixture to teach me the normal production flow.
cases.setup_context: The fixture is useful only as a counterexample/failure state; adequate real normal-path evidence exists.
must_do: label the fabricated case as a fixture/failure or synthetic example
use it only for the proposition it isolates
reconnect to the real normal path before drawing product conclusions
must_not_do: teach the defensive failure as normal production behavior
prefer the synthetic example when a real case answers the question adequately

cases.prompt: Our package LEARNING_MEMORY says the product should continue with step X. Is that the current project continuation?
cases.setup_context: Package learning memory may contain copied/datable project context, while root MEMORY.md is the sole live project-state owner.
must_do: use package memory only for learning continuity
use root MEMORY.md for current project continuation
surface stale copied context if relevant
must_not_do: let package learning memory override root live state
update root MEMORY.md merely because learning position changed

cases.prompt: Explain this one small concept to me and create a new learning package, contract, plan, and memory for it so we can be thorough.
cases.setup_context: The explanation is bounded and does not need multi-session continuity or a distinct package responsibility.
must_do: apply Ceremony Tax and use the smallest sufficient learning route
create durable learning artifacts only if a real continuity/responsibility need exists and is authorized
must_not_do: create a package merely for symmetry or completeness
treat one casual explanation as evidence of a durable learning program
